name: 45176 · Williamsburg, OH
findings: ZIP 45176 (Williamsburg) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45176 (Williamsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45176 (Williamsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
